changelog: TV remote: arrow keys seek while the timeline is hidden, and navigate the player buttons once it is visible
Remote focus always stays on the screen that is showing (player, then the page it returns to)
Back now shrinks the video into a floating mini player so the rest of the app keeps browsing with it playing; mini player gains play/pause, expand and close
Smaller fonts across both players, their menus and overlays
Link list shows the player each link was extracted from on its own small line under the link
New 'Search More Players for More Links' row at the end of the link list - probes the next player and appends higher-resolution links to the ones already fetched
Each link plays with the settings of the player it came from; stale settings from another player are dropped
Visible TV focus highlight on playlists, continue watching, downloads rows and the theme picker
HQ player menu labels every link with the player it was extracted from (Player 1 (Videasy), CineStream, Player 3 (AutoEmbed) ...)
Fetch More Links checks the next player only and waits for the next tap
Provider filter applies to Movies and TV shows; Home resets to All providers
